# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before proposing or changing code. It is the canonical project instruction.

Role and boundary contracts live in `.agents/skills/{name}/SKILL.md`. Each frontmatter `description` says when it applies and where to go instead. Use every matching project skill, and read its `references/` only when you hit what they describe. Do not create a Copilot-specific copy or index.
